title: Link to the other product where it is needed
problem: The extension never links to the desktop app, the desktop links to the extension only from Scribe, the guide offers only a web link.
fix: One shared "Get / Open <product>" action, used wherever a feature needs the other product: extension first run, Vault, Web Use, Pro page, guide topics.

items.screen: Extension panel: first open, 'Start Off Grid AI Desktop', and the pairing card
items.title: Extension never links to get the desktop app
items.what: With no desktop, the panel says 'Start Off Grid AI Desktop' or 'Check the desktop address... update it to the latest version'. No link to download the desktop exists anywhere in the extension source. The only actions are Retry and 'Change desktop address'.
items.risk: A person who installs the extension from the store first has a dead end. They do not learn that a separate app is needed or where to get it.
items.rec: Extension: add one 'Get Off Grid AI Desktop' button (getoffgridai.co/desktop) to DesktopOffline and to the unavailable pairing card. Say in one line that the panel needs the desktop app.

items.title: Scribe says 'Not connected' for a working browser
items.what: The desktop Scribe row lists browsers from the live socket. The extension opens that socket only when Web Use is set to Default browser and all-sites access is granted. Scribe itself runs over plain sealed calls. So a paired browser that uses Scribe shows as 'Not connected' with a 'Get the extension' button.
items.risk: The desktop tells a user to install an extension they already use. They cannot tell if Scribe works in the browser. The same 'Not connected' shows in the paired browser list.
items.rec: Desktop: build this row from the paired browser store plus last-call time, not from the live socket. Show 'Paired · Chrome' and offer 'Get the extension' only when no browser is paired.

items.screen: Desktop Vault, Web Use settings, Pro page, chat
items.title: Only Scribe links to the extension; link is Chrome-only
items.what: The 'Get the extension' button exists only on the Scribe screen (and the guide topic). The Vault screen never mentions the browser or autofill. Web Use shows a disabled option 'Default browser (pair the extension first)' and a text hint, with no link. The Pro page does not list it. The one link goes to the Chrome Web Store for every user.
items.risk: A Vault user never learns that the vault can fill and save passwords in the browser. A Web Use user must find the extension alone. A Firefox user is sent to a store that cannot install it.
items.rec: Desktop: add one shared 'Get the extension' action that opens the store for the default browser (Chrome or Firefox). Use it in the Vault header when no browser is paired, beside the disabled Web Use option, and on the Pro page.

items.screen: Desktop Tasks > Web Use > paired browsers; pairing dialog
items.title: Every Chrome pairs as 'Chrome extension'
items.what: The extension names itself from the browser brand only: 'Chrome extension', 'Firefox extension'. Two profiles, or Chrome on two computers, get the same name. The desktop list shows the name and Remove. The pairing dialog shows the same name. The Scribe row merges them as 'Chrome extension ×2'.
items.risk: The user cannot tell which row is which and may remove the wrong browser. In the pairing dialog a request from another device looks like their own.
items.rec: Desktop: show the paired date and the peer (this computer or its address) on each row. Extension: let the name be edited once in Settings > Desktop and send it at pairing.

items.title: Phone opens the Chrome Web Store for the extension
items.what: The phone's Pro tab lists 'Browser extension' and opens the shared link, which is the Chrome Web Store page. A phone cannot install a desktop Chrome extension. The row does not say it is for the computer or that it needs the desktop app. No Firefox link exists.
items.risk: The tap lands on a store page that cannot install anything on the phone. The loop ends there.
items.rec: Shared: point the extension link at a getoffgridai.co page that says 'On your computer' and offers Chrome and Firefox. Mobile: change the row line to say it runs in the browser on the computer, with the desktop app.

items.screen: Panel on first open: setup screen and "Start Off Grid AI Desktop" screen
items.title: First run: no way to get or open Desktop
items.what: The first screen is titled "Off Grid AI Pro" with a "Pair with desktop" button, or "Start Off Grid AI Desktop" with a spinner. Neither has a download link or an Open button. The panel has no link to the website anywhere. Scribe's badge already opens the app with offgrid://open.
items.risk: Someone who installed the extension from the store without the desktop app has no path forward. Someone with the app must go and find it by hand.
items.rec: On both screens add "Open Off Grid AI Desktop" (the existing offgrid://open) and "Get Off Grid AI Desktop" (website link). Title the unpaired screen "Connect to Off Grid AI Desktop"; keep "Off Grid AI Pro" for the no-Pro state only.

items.screen: Desktop guide topic 'Off Grid AI on your phone' and phone guide topic 'Off Grid AI on your computer'
items.title: Other-device topics offer only a web link
items.what: Both topics promise pairing ('Pair with your computer to share chats', 'Paired, your phone uses its models'). The only action is 'Get it', a web URL. On the phone it opens the desktop download page on the phone. No topic offers Devices, Sync, Remote servers or a QR to install.
items.risk: A user who already has both apps cannot get from the guide to pairing. A phone user is sent to a desktop download on a device that cannot install it.
items.rec: shared: add a second action per topic: desktop 'phone' opens Devices (pair QR); mobile 'computer' opens Remote servers > Scan network or Sync. Show 'Get it' only when no paired device is known.

items.title: Image and video downloads lack 'use it now'
items.what: A finished text model offers 'Chat now'. A finished image model shows '<name> is ready' with OK only. A finished video model shows nothing. An imported model says 'imported successfully' and is not selected. Video model errors (no space, another pack installed) appear as red text under the whole list.
items.risk: After a multi-gigabyte download you must work out where to make a picture or clip. A failed video download looks like nothing happened, because the reason is below the cards.
items.rec: Reuse the text pattern: 'Make an image', 'Make a video' (the chat opens in that mode), and select an imported model with 'Chat now'. Show video model errors in the alert sheet the card already has.
